text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It is a covert battle over secret 
chocolate—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Someone holding information on the deal 
for 'the goods' lurks in this city... 
Chan-chan, the wandering super spy, will 
surely obtain that intel!"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: —Now!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Do not move. I have questions for you. 
You know what I mean by 'the special 
chocolate,' don't you? Quietly hand over 
the information—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—Smack-bam!)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Wha...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"The chocolate...? What about it? 
I haven't the faintest idea what you're 
talking about."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"That move... A strike followed by a 
weapon disarm! 
Could you be—a master of Cute-Style 
Aikido?!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"—Fufu. You really are a capable spy, 
aren't you? 
Then all the more reason... I can't let 
you have this."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Ngh...! I will never give up. 
On my name as the wandering super-spy, 
Aston Machan...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The ultimate battle between Spy vs. 
Aikido Master— 
To be continued on Valentine's Day!!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"『What is this plot lmao』 『The Chan vs. 
Chan showdown is hilarious』 
『What's gonna happen on the day?!』 
...Man, the hype is real!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Impressions and 'Uma-Likes' are shooting 
up by the minute. 
...Everyone seems to be thoroughly 
enjoying it."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Fufufu. Machan's predictions were spot on.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Machan's spy persona and Curren-san's 
'actually a black belt' Aikido master 
persona. 
I just knew they would be a match made in 
heaven."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"The response has been splendid. Everyone, 
let's keep promoting the event 
with our own funny and cute short videos!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Funny videos, huh... Well, beats doing 
finger hearts and that kinda thing, I 
guess... 
Alrighty, got it."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Funny...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The next day.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Time for～ Teacher Nature's～ easy-peasy 
recipe remix～. 
Today, I'm sharing the snack-choc recipe I 
always eat!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"All the ingredients can be bought at any 
convenience store. Ta-da! 
Chocolate snacks, salami, cream cheese, 
and so on."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Use chocolate cookies as a base～, then 
stack the salami 
and cheese right on top. Ah, don't worry 
about being precise with the amounts."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"And done～! Super easy, sweet and salty 
party tapas! 
This is hands down the best companion for 
binge-watching UmaTube!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Whip it up real quick before our stream, 
and you can munch away while you watch... 
So yeah, highly recommended!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Wait... Is this really good enough? It's 
fine? For real...?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The following day.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Now then... Level 1: Handheld selfie—here 
I go!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hold it like this... keep my arm steady... 
Hah!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Alright! That felt pretty— 
Ah, it's so blurry it looks like an 
afterimage...!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Level 3: Using the timer to snap a 
picture mid-jump! 
I will capture it—the absolute perfect 
timing!!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"~~~Ngh...! I don't even need to look to 
know...! 
I focused so much on the timing that I 
barely got off the ground...!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"I will become a master of selfies before 
Valentine's Day arrives. 
Please, stay tuned...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —That night.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So, we've been posting short videos for a 
few days now...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"To put it plainly: phenomenal success! 
Tons of related keywords are trending, 
and the reception is top-notch, truly 
truly."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, my video has also...— 
Fufu... received so many lovely comments."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"How about you, Zephyr? 
Got any ideas for your short video yet?"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Well...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"I have pondered it in many ways... 
Yet, I remain trapped in a perplexing 
breeze..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I see, I see. Well, no need to force it. 
Besides, our mini stream is starting soon 
anyway."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"You might find some inspiration there. 
Just relax your shoulders and have fun 
with it."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"... 
...Yes, you are right—"
